In which reaction does an acid react with a base?
A
Dilute sulfuric acid is added to a piece of magnesium ribbon producing hydrogen.
B
Dilute sulfuric acid is added to aqueous barium chloride producing a white precipitate of
barium sulfate.
C
Aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to aqueous copper(II) sulfate producing a blue
precipitate of copper(II) hydroxide.
D
Aqueous sodium hydroxide is added to solid ammonium sulfate producing gaseous
ammonia.
